Role
  
  

* Design and develop high quality, secure, scalable software solutions based on technical requirements specifications and design artifacts within expected time and budget.
* Work closely with Product Owners to develop beautiful, usable UIs and creative visualizations.
* Stay abreast of latest on the technology trends and industry best practices to hone and maintain your talent.
* Participate in architectural discussions, iteration planning, and feature sizing meetings.
* Develop code of high quality with customer focussed approach.
* Provide support during System and User Acceptance Testing.
* Adhere to Agile processes and participate actively in agile ceremonies.

* Strong 3-6 years of experience in Full Stack Java application development and support, using modern and industry-standard development tools and practices.

* Proven experience in developing RESTful web services using Spring Boot / Spring REST APIs.
* Solid understanding of relational databases such as Oracle or SQL Server, with expertise in writing optimized and performant SQL queries.
* Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React or Angular for building responsive user interfaces.
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, Maven/Gradle, SonarQube, Chef, or equivalent automation tools.

* Good understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and experience working in Agile (Scrum/Kanban) methodologies.
* Experience working in global, cross-functional teams, with strong technical problem-solving skills.

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

title: System Software Engineer - GPU Profiling
description:
At NVIDIA, we build groundbreaking products for the following sectors: Deep Learning, High Performance Computing, Gaming, VR, and Automotive. See your efforts in action as developers use your tools to debug, profile and analyze the performance of their systems/applications using the low-level library that you helped to craft as a member of the GPU Foundations Developer Tools team! Innovate as you develop the performance analysis capabilities of NVIDIA hardware along with the Nsight tools and the foundation library to support next generation accelerated computing at datacenter scale.
  
  
As a system software engineer in the Developer Tools group, you will be developing software that empowers GPU application developers to build outstanding applications that are recognized world-wide. We are seeking a motivated Software Engineer to join our team and contribute to the performance triage development and co-design of our software libraries in collaboration with our Hardware Architecture team. Join our team and gain exciting opportunities to work hands-on at every layer of NVIDIA's outstanding technology.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Partner with multi-disciplinary teams to design, implement, and verify performance metrics for NVIDIA GPUs
* Work on developing and improving methodologies for profiling data collection from GPUs
* Define, invent, and improve our GPU profiling library with new features to allow NVIDIA's customers to extract the best performance out of their applications
* Read and understand HW specs to design solutions based on it
* Work on software unit level tests and framework ensuring the quality of the product
* Work on supporting a variety of platforms ranging from super-computers to embedded systems

**What We Need To See**

* B.Tech. EE/CS or equivalent with 4+ years of experience, or M.Tech. with 2+ years of experience, or Ph.D.
* Strong programming ability in C, C++, Python with proficiency in Data Structures and Algorithms
* Solid understanding of Computer Architecture (e.g. x86, ARM CPUs, GPUs) and Operating System concepts
* Knowledge of SW design principles, as that's a key as we scale!

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience in Device Drivers or System Software development
* Knowledge of GPU APIs such as CUDA, OpenCL, OpenGL, Direct3D, Vulkan
* Prior experience authoring developer tools, particularly for GPUs
* Experience in performance analysis of GPU applications
* Ability to read and write in Assembly language, especially for multi-processor architectures

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most dedicated and hard-working people in the world working with us. If the work described above excites you and you are up to the challenge, we want to hear from you. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for phenomenal people in multiple disciplines to help us accelerate the next wave of computing.
  
  
NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

These include agents that make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs, handle complex multi-step workflows, and deliver secure, scalable, reliable results. You'll work across agent orchestration, tool calling, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps, help set the engineering standard for Gen AI development, and mentor other engineers on the team. Much of this work is strong backend engineering. If you bring deep experience building production services and have started building with LLMs, we'd love to
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect and build the tool-calling layer that powers our agents: wrap internal services, data platforms, and external APIs as well-defined tools with clear schemas, contracts, and permissions.
* Engineer reliable tool execution at scale, including parallel and chained tool calls, timeouts, retries, idempotency, error recovery, and graceful handling of tool failures or bad model outputs.
* Develop high-performance Python backend services for LLM orchestration, covering async job handling, streaming responses, caching, rate limiting, and distributed workflows supporting high-throughput Gen AI operations.
* Engineer state, memory, and context management subsystems so agents can maintain session continuity across long, multi-step, tool-heavy interactions.
* Architect multi-agent and skills-based agent systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar, enabling autonomous reasoning, tool use, inter-agent coordination, and adaptive decision-making at enterprise scale.
* Build observability for agent behavior, including end-to-end tracing of tool calls, measuring tool-selection accuracy, and debugging multi-step agent runs in production.
* Build retrieval systems (RAG and Graph-RAG) where agents need grounded knowledge, using vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
* Establish LLMOps and MLOps pipelines on Databricks (AWS), covering MLflow, prompt and agent evaluation, model lineage tracking, CI/CD, and monitoring.
* Design multimodal generative AI pipelines that unify text, image, tabular, and graph data using modern transformer-based and foundation models.
* Guide fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and alignment strategies (e.g., PEFT, LoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF) to adapt foundation models for specialized enterprise use cases, working closely with ML specialists.
* Implement Responsible AI practices, including hallucination mitigation, bias detection, output safety guardrails, explainability, and compliance with data ethics standards.
* Evaluate and productionize advances in agentic AI, multimodal models, and frontier foundation models, benchmarking them against enterprise performance and safety requirements.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of engineers, and set the engineering standard for Gen AI development across the program.

**All About You**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* A strong track record of building and operating production backend systems at scale, including distributed services, APIs, async processing, data stores, and observability.
* Strong API design and integration experience: you know how to build services that other systems, and now LLMs, can call safely and reliably.
* Excellent Python engineering skills, including async programming, API development (FastAPI or similar), and microservices, plus SQL proficiency.
* Hands-on experience shipping at least one LLM-powered application to production that uses tool/function calling, such as agents that call APIs, query databases, or trigger workflows. This can be with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source models.
* A working understanding of Gen AI engineering patterns, such as prompt design, embeddings, semantic search, and agent memory, or a demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on new technical domains.
* Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome).
* Experience leading or mentoring engineers, plus strong communication and stakeholder management skills. You should be able to translate technical work into business value.
* Nice to have: experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or building tool servers and connectors for LLM agents.
* Nice to have: experience evaluating agent performance, such as tool-selection accuracy, task completion rates, or multi-step reasoning reliability.
* Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, knowledge graphs, or MLOps tooling like MLflow, Weights & Biases, SageMaker, or Bedrock.
* Coming from a backend background? We value engineers who take AI from prototype to production as much as those who train the models. If you've built high-throughput systems and started applying those skills to LLM-powered products, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't worked with every tool listed here

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
We are looking for a experienced AI/ML Engineer to design, build, and deploy machine learning models and intelligent systems that solve real business problems at scale. This role has a strong focus on modern generative AI — building LLM-powered applications, RAG pipelines, and agentic AI systems — alongside classical ML. You will work across the full ML/AI lifecycle, from data exploration and model development to production deployment and monitoring, partnering closely with Data Science, Product, and Platform Engineering teams. This role suits someone who enjoys turning research and prototypes into reliable, production-grade systems.
  
  
You will be reporting to Team Lead-IT
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Design and build LLM-powered applications, RAG pipelines, and agentic AI workflows to automate and augment business processes.
* Stay current with the latest ML/AI research (including LLMs, RAG, and agentic systems) and evaluate applicability to company use cases.
* Document architectures, experiments, and decisions; contribute to internal ML standards, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
* Ensure responsible AI practices — fairness, explainability, privacy, and security — are embedded throughout model development
* Build and maintain robust, scalable data pipelines for feature engineering, model training, and inference (batch and real-time).
* Deploy models into production using MLOps best practices — CI/CD for ML, containerization, model versioning, and automated retraining pipelines.
* Monitor deployed models for drift, performance degradation, bias, and data quality issues; implement retraining and alerting strategies.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers to ensure clean, reliable, and well-governed data is available for model development.
* Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into ML solutions and model capabilities, limitations, and trade-offs.
* Conduct experiments (A/B tests, offline evaluation) to validate model performance and business impact.
* Optimize models for latency, throughput, and cost (quantization, distillation, pruning, efficient inference serving).

**The Essentials – You Will Have**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Machine Learning, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 2–5+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning models in production.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong programming skills in Python; familiarity with SQL
* Proficiency with ML/DL frameworks: TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM.
* 3+ years of experience with the ML lifecycle: data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, hyperparameter tuning, evaluation, and deployment.
* Hands-on experience with MLOps tooling: MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI, Airflow, or similar for experiment tracking, orchestration, and deployment.
* Solid understanding of statistics, probability, linear algebra, and core ML/DL algorithms.
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure) and containerization/orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with distributed data processing (Spark, Ray, Dask) and data pipeline/orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster).
* 3+ years of experience with model serving and APIs (FastAPI/Flask, TorchServe, Triton Inference Server, or similar).
* Version control (Git) and CI/CD practices for ML systems.

Generative AI, LLMs & Agentic Applications (Essential)
  
  

* Hands-on experience building applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) — e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Llama, Mistral, or Gemini APIs.
* Practical experience designing and implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including chunking strategies, embeddings, and retrieval evaluation.
* Experience building agentic AI systems / multi-step autonomous workflows (tool use, function calling, planning, orchestration) using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar.

* Understanding of the trade-offs, latency, cost, and safety considerations of deploying LLM- and agent-based applications in production.

**The Preferred – You Might Also Have**

* Contributions to open-source LLM/RAG tooling, or published work on GenAI applications.

title: Senior Business and Data Analyst
description:
**About Us**
Abacus Insights is transforming how data and AI work for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence.
  
  
As the AI and Data Platform for Payer Intelligence, we help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions—so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we're tackling big challenges in an industry that's ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows—and it's why we are leading the way.
  
  
Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable—those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work—while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Join us and let's build the future together.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced Business and Data Analyst to join our team. In this role, you'll be the analytical engine between a client's business need and the data solution that delivers it. You'll turn business questions into precise, testable requirements, then use the data itself to prove out what's possible: profiling sources, validating assumptions, and shaping designs that are clean, buildable, and grounded in evidence rather than opinion. You'll own the requirements and analysis for your use cases and workstreams, working in close partnership with Business Solution Managers who hold the broader engagement.
  
  
Doing that well takes two things at once: command of healthcare business context, and deep, hands-on fluency in the data. This is a client-facing role. You'll translate complex healthcare challenges into rigorous requirements, and you'll use SQL and analytical judgment to show clients and delivery teams what the data actually says, where it falls short, and what that means for the design.
  
  
No engagement lives in isolation. A data model built for one client's use case can share structure with a completely different client's need; a transformation rule written for one state's requirements often anticipates the next state's. You'll learn to see each requirement as part of a larger system of clients, states, use cases, and data flows, and to flag where a design can be reused or where it could collide with other work.
  
  
Our clients are US health plans and the partners who serve them, and the engagements span everything it takes to make their data usable. That can mean standardizing and migrating data onto a new platform, meeting evolving regulatory and compliance mandates, or powering the broader analytics and reporting programs that drive payer performance across Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial lines of business.
  
  
**Your day to day**
**Analyze the Data and Build the Evidence**

* Write and execute SQL daily to profile source data, test assumptions, quantify data quality (completeness, validity, uniqueness, consistency, timeliness), and prototype logic before it reaches the build team.
* Analyze source data to establish what is actually available and reliable: field population and distributions, key integrity, duplicates, outliers, and gaps against what the business use case needs.
* Reconcile and validate outputs against source systems and client-provided benchmarks (claim counts, member months, paid amounts, enrollment spans, provider rosters), investigating variances to root cause and documenting findings.
* Define and document business metrics and KPIs precisely: numerator, denominator, inclusion and exclusion logic, time basis, and grain, so every consumer of the data calculates and reads them the same way.
* Perform exploratory and root-cause analysis on client questions and data anomalies, and turn findings into clear, quantified recommendations for client and internal audiences.
* Summarize findings through data profiling reports, analysis readouts, and visualizations that make the story clear to non-technical stakeholders.

**Drive Requirements And Design For Your Use Cases**

* Lead discovery sessions for your use cases, and support broader engagement-level sessions alongside the Business Solution Manager, to understand the why and what behind each use case: the business context, pain points, expected outcomes, and success criteria, rather than just the surface-level data ask.
* Translate each use case into clear, testable requirements, including success criteria and non-functional requirements, and maintain traceability from business need to requirement to design to test.
* Use data analysis to sharpen and challenge requirements: confirm that what the client is asking for is supported by the data they have, and surface gaps early.
* Document source-to-target mappings, transformation logic, and business rules that developers can build from, and define the test conditions and expected results QA will use to validate them.
* Recommend the appropriate grain and structure of a dataset given the business context, and analyze how that grain decision ripples into the downstream reports, models, or programs that consume the data.
* Identify dependencies before a design is finalized: which other workstreams, reports, or client use cases touch this same data, and how a change here could break or benefit them, escalating cross-workstream impacts to the Business Solution Manager.
* Apply systems thinking: recognize when a design built for one client, state, or use case can become a reusable pattern, and raise and shape that reuse rather than discovering it in hindsight.

**Be a Trusted Client-Facing Partner**

* Drive requirements-gathering and clarification conversations with client SMEs for your use cases, since incomplete or poorly elicited requirements undermine everything built downstream.
* Present analysis results, data quality findings, and recommendations to client stakeholders with clarity and confidence, and guide decisions with evidence.
* Represent client intent for your use cases through delivery and serve as a day-to-day point of contact, with the Business Solution Manager owning the overall client relationship.
* Translate fluently between business and technical audiences, so both sides share the same understanding.

**Collaborate Across Delivery**

* Connect the client and the internal team on your workstreams, holding the business context, data findings, and design drivers that shape the build.
* Act as the business and data analysis SME for Solution Architects, Product, QA, Account Management, and Program Management, giving them clean hand-offs with the context, business rules, and analysis they need to execute without rework or reinterpretation.
* Support QA and UAT by supplying validation queries, expected results, and variance analysis, and by helping triage defects to business rule, mapping, or source data causes.
* Maintain awareness of the wider engagement: understand how a decision made for one workstream affects the others, and flag those ripple effects before they surface as rework.

**What You Bring To The Team**

* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 5+ years working in the US healthcare domain and with healthcare data (claims, provider, membership/eligibility, benefits, prior authorization, or PBM).
* Payer experience required: direct experience working with or for a US health plan (Medicare, Medicaid, or Commercial), whether in-house or through healthcare consulting.
* Working command of core payer concepts such as membership/enrollment, provider, claims, and authorizations, enough to reason about business context rather than specialize narrowly in any one area.
* Strong, hands-on SQL: comfortable with joins across large, multi-table datasets, window functions, CTEs, aggregations, and date/span logic, used regularly to profile, validate, reconcile, and analyze data.
* Demonstrated analytical rigor: a track record of profiling data, assessing data quality, investigating anomalies to root cause, and communicating quantified findings that drove a decision.
* Experience defining metrics, mentoring junior analysts, and eliciting and authoring business requirements in complex, data-driven environments.
* Confident client-facing communication; able to drive a conversation, elicit requirements clearly, and present analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Comfort operating with ambiguity and re-prioritizing frequently while managing multiple use cases within a larger engagement.
* Developing systems thinking: experience designing for reuse and scale across states, clients, or use cases rather than solving each case in isolation, and the ability to trace how a requirement or data model decision affects other parts of a larger data ecosystem.

**What We Would Like To See, But Not Required**

* Exposure to Databricks or Snowflake
* Experience with BI and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or similar) to communicate analysis.
* Familiarity with HEDIS and Stars quality reporting, risk adjustment, payment integrity, value-based care analytics, provider data management, or CMS interoperability (CMS-0057).
* Working knowledge of data modeling concepts, including how the grain and structure of a dataset shape its downstream use.
* Familiarity with Python or similar for analysis and automation.

**Compensation**
Compensation for this role is based on experience, skills, and location, and includes base salary plus eligibility for performance bonuses and equity grants.
  
  
**What You’ll Get In Return**

* Competitive Leave & Benefits
* Comprehensive health coverage
* Equity for every employee – share in our success
* Growth-focused environment – your development matters here

**Work arrangements**

* Standard hours: 9 hours/day, 5 days/week
* Location: Pune, Onsite (1 PM - 10 PM IST)
* Shift: Your standard working hours will be nine (9) hours per day within the Company’s standard working hours. Specific working hours may vary based on business needs.

**Our Commitment as an Equal Opportunity Employer**
As a mission-led technology company helping to drive better healthcare outcomes, Abacus Insights believes that the best innovation and value we can bring to our customers comes from diverse ideas, thoughts, experiences, and perspectives. Therefore, we dedicate resources to building diverse teams and providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants. Abacus prohibits discrimination and harassment regarding race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
At the heart of who we are is a commitment to continuously and intentionally building an inclusive culture—one that empowers every team member across the globe to do their best work and bring their authentic selves. We carry that same commitment into our hiring process, aiming to create an interview experience where you feel comfortable and confident showcasing your strengths. If there’s anything we can do to support that—big or small—please let us know.
  
  
**AI Use in Recruitment**
We use AI-powered tools throughout our recruitment process. This includes Greenhouse's Real Talent Matching Technology, which helps prioritize applications based on job-related criteria, as well as additional AI tools used to support sourcing, interview preparation, and other recruiting tasks.
**We do not remove the human element—our recruiters and hiring teams review all applications and make all decisions related to candidate progression and hiring, regardless of which tools are used to support that process.**
**Identity and Location Verification**
To protect the integrity of our hiring process, all interviews are conducted by live video with your camera on. Virtual or blurred backgrounds and headsets are not permitted absent an approved accommodation, and you should be in a well-lit, private space where your face and surroundings are clearly visible. Candidates who advance may also be asked to complete identity and location verification, which may include verifying your identity, work history, and confirming that you are located where your application states. Applications containing knowingly false or materially misrepresented information, including identity, location, or credentials, may be disqualified, and any offer may be rescinded if a material misrepresentation is discovered at any point in the process.
  
  
If you need an accommodation for any part of the interview process, please let your recruiter know in advance.
  
  
By applying, you acknowledge that we will collect and process your personal information for recruiting purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including for the verification steps described above. title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**At Global IT Hub, we are more than a technology organization. We are a community of innovators, problem-solvers, and digital pioneers dedicated to accelerating Atlas Copco Group’s business potential through world-class technology solutions. Join us to shape the future of digital transformation, work on global challenges, and create impact for businesses and customers worldwide.**
**CLASSICAL MACHINE LEARNING | JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Role purpose**
Lead the design, validation, deployment and lifecycle ownership of production-grade classical machine learning solutions that convert business problems into measurable outcomes. The role combines deep algorithmic expertise, disciplined CRISP-DM execution, MLOps practices and senior technical leadership.
  
  
Role at a glance
  
  
**Team**
AI Team, Global IT Hub
  
  
**Primary Stakeholders**
Business product owners, IT, data engineering, analytics and domain teams
  
  
**Experience**
5+ years in data science / machine learning, including 3+ years owning production ML solutions
  
  
**Education**
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering or a related quantitative field
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Partner with stakeholders to frame ambiguous business needs as well-defined machine learning problems, including decision context, baselines, constraints, risks and measurable success criteria.
* Lead end-to-end delivery using CRISP-DM: business understanding, data understanding, data preparation, modeling, evaluation and deployment, with iteration and traceability across phases.
* Design, train and compare classical supervised and unsupervised learning models; select the simplest approach that meets performance, interpretability, latency, scalability and cost requirements.
* Own feature engineering, data leakage prevention, sampling strategy, cross-validation, hyperparameter optimization, threshold selection, calibration and robust error analysis.
* Build reliable evaluation frameworks using fit-for-purpose metrics, statistical tests, confidence intervals, business-cost functions and champion-challenger comparisons.
* Take models from experimentation to production with engineering teams, covering packaging, APIs or batch scoring, versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, retraining and rollback.
* Own post-production performance, including drift detection, data-quality controls, incident analysis, model refresh decisions and communication of model limitations.
* Apply explainability and responsible AI practices through model cards, reproducibility, bias and fairness checks, audit trails, privacy-aware design and human oversight.
* Set technical standards, conduct design and code reviews, mentor data scientists, create reusable components and influence the classical ML roadmap.
* Communicate recommendations, uncertainty, assumptions and trade-offs clearly to technical teams, business leaders and governance forums.

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

* Advanced Python and SQL, with strong hands-on use of NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, SciPy and statsmodels; ability to write modular, tested and maintainable code.
* Deep knowledge of regression and classification: linear and logistic regression, regularization, decision trees, Random Forest, Extra Trees, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, support vector machines, k-nearest neighbors, Naive Bayes and appropriate ensemble methods.
* Strong understanding of unsupervised learning: k-means and hierarchical clustering, DBSCAN, PCA and other dimensionality-reduction methods, anomaly or outlier detection and segmentation evaluation.
* Practical knowledge of forecasting and statistical modeling, including ARIMA/SARIMA, exponential smoothing, trend and seasonality, lag features, back-testing and prediction intervals.
* Expertise in feature selection and engineering, missing-value treatment, categorical encoding, class imbalance, resampling, pipeline design and prevention of target leakage.
* Rigorous evaluation skills across ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, precision, recall, F1, log loss, RMSE, MAE, MAPE/WAPE, lift, gain, calibration and business-impact metrics, selected according to the use case.
* Hands-on optimization using grid, random or Bayesian search, with sound cross-validation design for grouped, temporal and imbalanced datasets.
* Practical MLOps experience with experiment tracking, model registry, source control, automated testing, Docker, CI/CD, deployment and model or data monitoring.
* Working knowledge of explainability techniques such as feature importance, permutation importance, partial dependence and SHAP, including their limitations.
* Experience handling large structured datasets and collaborating on scalable data pipelines in a cloud or distributed environment.

Senior-level capabilities
  
  

* Independently owns technical direction and delivery for complex ML use cases from discovery through production adoption.
* Challenges weak problem formulations and prevents unnecessary use of ML when rules, analytics or simpler statistical methods are more suitable.
* Makes defensible trade-offs among accuracy, interpretability, maintainability, latency and cost.
* Reviews experimental design and model evidence before approving production release.
* Mentors team members and raises standards for coding, documentation, reproducibility and stakeholder communication.

Good-to-have experience
  
  

* Domain exposure in manufacturing, industrial operations, supply chain, service, pricing, finance, sales or customer analytics.
* Optimization, causal inference, survival analysis, uplift modeling, recommendation systems, geospatial analytics or graph-based techniques.
* Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, MLflow, Spark and enterprise data sources such as SAP.
* Experience integrating classical ML models into applications, APIs, decision-support workflows or Power BI solutions.
* Awareness of deep learning and generative AI, with the judgment to benchmark them against classical ML rather than defaulting to higher-complexity approaches.

Core algorithm and method coverage
  
  
Candidates are expected to demonstrate depth in several categories and sound model-selection judgment across the full landscape. This is not a requirement to have used every library or algorithm in production.
  
  
**Capability area**
**Expected knowledge**
**Supervised learning**
Regression, classification, tree ensembles, boosting, SVM, nearest-neighbor and probabilistic baselines.
  
  
**Unsupervised learning**
Clustering, dimensionality reduction, anomaly detection and segmentation validation.
  
  
**Time-dependent modeling**
Forecasting, temporal validation, lag and rolling features, seasonality and uncertainty.
  
  
**Data and features**
EDA, data-quality assessment, transformations, encoding, imbalance handling and leakage control.
  
  
**Evaluation**
Metric selection, baselines, validation design, statistical significance, calibration and business value.
  
  
**Production lifecycle**
Reproducibility, versioning, deployment, observability, drift, retraining and retirement.
  
  
**Governance**
Explainability, documentation, bias and fairness assessment, privacy, approvals and auditability.
  
  
What you can expect from us
  
  

* Meaningful global business problems and access to cross-functional expertise.
* Freedom to choose fit-for-purpose methods and challenge unnecessary complexity.
* A collaborative environment focused on engineering quality, responsible AI and measurable value.
* Opportunities to mentor, build reusable capabilities and shape the enterprise AI practice.

At Global IT Hub, we believe exceptional talent drives exceptional transformation. As a strategic partner for next-generation digital transformation, we empower our people to innovate boldly, collaborate globally, and turn ideas into solutions that create lasting business value. Join a team where learning never stops, innovation is part of our DNA, and your contribution helps shape the future of a global industry leader.
  
  
Role Evolution – Next 3–4 Years
  
  

* Evolve from predictive modelling toward decision intelligence, combining prediction, causal analysis, simulation and optimization.
* Build hybrid AI solutions integrating classical ML with Generative AI, foundation models and AI agents.
* Establish systematic benchmarking across classical ML, deep learning and emerging AI models to select the best approach based on performance, explainability, scalability and cost.
* Drive automation of the end-to-end ML lifecycle, including feature engineering, experimentation, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining and model retirement.
* Develop advanced model evaluation frameworks covering technical performance, business impact, robustness, explainability, fairness and operational reliability.
* Advance model observability and continuous learning, proactively managing data drift, concept drift and model degradation.
* Strengthen Responsible AI and model governance, including lineage, reproducibility, explainability, bias assessment, human oversight and auditability.
* Develop reusable ML frameworks, components and engineering standards to accelerate enterprise-wide AI development.

title: Business Analyst (Context Layer and Semantic Layer)
description:
**Sr. Business Analyst – India (Semantic Layer and Context Layer )**

**About SailPoint:**

Love what you do. And love where you do it. Smart people, fun culture, innovative work, beautiful offices — oh, and everyone’s really nice. That’s what people say about SailPoint. We’re known as the company where everyone wants to work, and employee reviews about us prove it. If you’re passionate about  AI Context Layer, Semantic Layer modeling and working at a company where you  can truly have an impact, join our team. SailPoint empowers the largest, most complex organizations by putting identity at the Centre of Security and IT. Our 2,000+ customers include global financial institutions, government entities, and pharmaceutical organizations and more.

**About the Role**

We are building the semantic and contextual foundation that powers our AI agent and agentic analytics platform. As Senior Business Analyst, you will own the translation of business knowledge — metrics, entities, business rules, and domain context — into structured, machine-consumable semantic and context layers that AI agents rely on to reason over enterprise data accurately and safely.

Unlike a traditional BI-focused semantic layer built for dashboards, this role treats the
**semantic layer as the "vocabulary" and the context layer as the "grounding Business context knowledge Base "**
that an LLM-powered agent uses at query/inference time — to disambiguate business terms, retrieve the right data, apply correct business logic, and avoid hallucinated or incorrect answers when a business user asks a natural-language question like
*"What was our churn last quarter by region?"*

You'll sit at the intersection of business analysis, data architecture, and applied AI — working closely with AI/ML engineers, platform architects, and business stakeholders to ensure the agent's "understanding" of the business is accurate, current, and governed.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Semantic Layer for Agent Consumption**

* Define and maintain the semantic model (metrics, dimensions, entities, synonyms, relationships) that AI agents use to map natural-language business questions to correct data queries (SQL, semantic layer APIs, or knowledge graph traversals)
* Design metric and entity definitions with agent-readability in mind: unambiguous naming, explicit synonyms/aliases, disambiguation rules for overloaded business terms (e.g., "revenue" meaning different things in different departments)
* Partner with AI engineers to structure the semantic layer for tool-calling/function-calling patterns — ensuring agents select the right metric, filter, and grain when generating queries
* Continuously test and tune semantic definitions against agent query failures, misinterpretations, and hallucination patterns

**Context Layer & Grounding for AI Agents**

* Design the context layer that supplies agents with the business rules, caveats, definitions, data lineage, and usage guardrails needed to ground responses (e.g., via RAG retrieval, system prompts, or structured metadata injection)
* Curate and structure business context objects — glossaries, policy documents, calculation logic, exceptions/edge cases — into formats optimized for retrieval (chunking strategy, embeddings-friendly structure, metadata tagging)
* Define context scoping and prioritization rules so agents retrieve the
  *most relevant and correct*
  context per query, minimizing noise and conflicting information
* Work with platform teams to version and govern context content so agent behavior stays aligned as business rules evolve

**Agent Behaviour & Quality Assurance**

* Partner with AI/ML engineers to evaluate agent outputs against expected business answers; identify root causes when agents misinterpret semantic or contextual inputs
* Build test question sets ("golden queries") representing real business questions to validate semantic/context layer coverage and accuracy
* Define feedback loops where incorrect agent responses trace back to semantic gaps, missing context, or ambiguous definitions — and drive remediation
* Support prompt/context engineering efforts by translating business nuance into structured inputs agents can reliably use

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Act as the primary bridge between business domain experts and the AI platform/engineering team, ensuring business intent is faithfully encoded into semantic and context structures
* Collaborate with Business Stakeholder, data engineers and architects to ensure the underlying data model supports the semantic layer the agent depends on
* Work with data governance teams to ensure context/semantic content meets accuracy, security, and access-control standards (e.g., row-level security respected by agent-generated queries)

**Documentation & Governance**

* Maintain a living business glossary and context repository that serves as the authoritative source for both human users and AI agents
* Document the semantic layer's coverage, known gaps, and disambiguation logic for auditability
* Establish a review/change-management process for updating semantic and context definitions as the business evolves, without degrading agent performance

**Required Qualifications**

* 6+ years as a Business Analyst, Data Analyst, or Knowledge/Ontology Analyst, with recent exposure to AI/LLM-powered platforms, copilots, or agentic systems
* Strong grasp of semantic modeling concepts (metrics layers, ontologies, knowledge graphs) and how they differ when designed for machine/agent consumption vs. human dashboards
* Understanding of how LLMs consume structured context — RAG architectures, embeddings, chunking strategies, function/tool calling, prompt/context engineering
* Experience translating ambiguous business language into precise, structured, disambiguated definitions
* Strong SQL skills and ability to work with data models, APIs, or knowledge graphs that agents query against
* Experience writing and structuring documentation (glossaries, business rules, metadata) in formats consumable by both people and AI systems
* Excellent stakeholder management — able to extract and reconcile business logic from multiple domain experts

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with semantic layer tools (such as UnifyApp, Atlan, dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, AtScale, LookML)
  *and*
  AI orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar)
* Experience with vector databases and RAG pipeline design (such as Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, etc.)
* Familiarity with knowledge graph technologies (Neo4j, RDF/OWL) for entity/relationship modeling
* Experience evaluating LLM/agent outputs — building eval harnesses, golden datasets, or human-in-the-loop review processes
* Background in AI governance, model risk, or responsible AI practices as applied to enterprise data
* Exposure to enterprise data catalogs (Collibra, Alation, Atlan, Purview) and metadata management

**What Success Looks Like**

* AI agents consistently interpret business questions correctly because the semantic layer resolves ambiguity before the query is even generated
* Agent responses are grounded in accurate, current business context — reducing hallucinations and incorrect metric usage
* Business stakeholders trust agent-generated insights because the underlying semantic/context layer is transparent, auditable, and governed
* A measurable reduction in agent query failures/misinterpretations over time, tracked via golden-query test suites

This role defines
*what*
the agent should know and
*how*
it's structured (business/semantic ownership), while assuming AI/ML engineers own the underlying retrieval and orchestration infrastructure.

**30-60-90 Day Plan: Sr. Business Analyst – Semantic & Context Layer for AI Agents**

**Phase 1: Days 1–30 — Learn, Map, Assess**

**Theme:**
Understand the business, the data, the current AI agent/platform state, and where the gaps are.

**Key Activities**

* Meet with Busienss Stakeholders, AI/ML engineering, data platform, and architecture teams to understand the current agent stack (LLM used, orchestration framework, RAG setup, semantic layer tooling if any)
* Meet with business stakeholders across key domains (Finance, Sales, Ops, Marketing , IT, HR, GTM, etc.) to understand how they currently define and use core metrics/entities
* Inventory existing semantic assets: BI semantic layers, data dictionaries, business glossaries, metric definitions — assess quality, coverage, and consistency
* Run/observe the AI agent (if live) against a sample of real business questions; log where it fails, hallucinates, or misinterprets terms
* Review existing data models, lineage documentation, and access/security controls relevant to agent queries
* Identify 3–5 high-value, high-ambiguity business domains to prioritize (e.g., Marketing, Salesforce (L2C), revenue, churn, customer segmentation)

**Deliverables**

* Current-state assessment document: semantic layer maturity, context layer gaps, agent failure patterns
* Initial glossary of top ambiguous/overloaded business terms
* Initial Context Layer and Semantic Layer – List of Objects, Tables , Fiels , Domain Terms, Rules, process if any , Metrics and Formulae.
* Stakeholder map (who owns which metrics/definitions)
* List of 15–20 "golden queries" collected from real business users to use as early test cases
* Complete 3 Pilot usecases for Context Layer

**Success Markers**

* Clear understanding of where agent inaccuracy stems from (semantic gaps vs. context gaps vs. data model issues)
* Relationships established with AI engineering and key business stakeholders

**Phase 2: Days 31–60 — Design, Build, Test**

**Theme:**
Start building and iterating on the semantic/context layer for the priority domains identified in Phase 1.

**Key Activities**

* Define structured metric and entity specs for priority domains: name, definition, synonyms/aliases, calculation logic, grain, owner
* Design disambiguation rules for known overloaded terms (e.g., department-specific "revenue" definitions)
* Structure context objects (business rules, caveats, exceptions) for RAG retrieval — work with AI engineers on chunking, tagging, and metadata format
* Run the golden-query set against the agent before and after semantic/context updates; document accuracy shifts
* Set up a lightweight review/change-management process for updating definitions without breaking agent behavior
* Begin building the living business glossary / context repository as the shared source of truth
* Establish a feedback loop: agent failure → root cause tagged (semantic gap, context gap, data issue) → routed to fix owner

**Deliverables**

* Semantic layer v1 for 3–5 priority domains, live in the agent's query/tool-calling logic
* Context layer v1 (structured business rules/definitions) integrated into RAG or prompt context
* Expanded golden-query test suite (40–50 queries) with pass/fail tracking
* First iteration of the governance/change-management process doc

**Success Markers**

* Measurable improvement in agent accuracy on golden queries for priority domains (target: define a baseline % and improvement goal, e.g., 60% → 80%)
* Business stakeholders in priority domains have reviewed and signed off on definitions
* A repeatable process exists for adding new metrics/context to the layer

* Document known limitations and a roadmap for the next 90 days (e.g., additional domains, knowledge graph expansion, more advanced disambiguation)

**Deliverables**

* Documented, governed semantic + context layer covering majority of high-value business domains
* Ongoing QA/eval process with historical accuracy tracking
* Stakeholder-facing readout: impact summary (accuracy improvement, reduced hallucinations, adoption metrics)
* 90-day forward roadmap

**Success Markers**

* Agent demonstrates sustained, measurable accuracy improvement across expanded domains
* Governance process is operating without the BA being a bottleneck for every change
* Leadership/stakeholders have visibility into and confidence in the semantic/context layer's value
